proposals.before: In the eleventh month of the third year of Kaiping, Emperor Taizu of Liang ordered Grand Master of Splendid Happiness Li Yan, Censor Xiao Qi, Secretariat Drafter Zhang Chong, Vice Minister of Revenue Cui Yi, Minister of Justice Wang Shan, and Director of the Bureau of Punishments Cui Gao to revise the statutes, ordinances, formats, and regulations together.
proposals.after: In the eleventh month of the third year of Kaiping, Emperor Taizu of Liang ordered Grand Master of Splendid Happiness Li Yan, Censor Xiao Qing, Secretariat Drafter Zhang Chong, Vice Minister of Revenue Cui Yi, Minister of Justice Wang Shan, and Director of the Bureau of Punishments Cui Gao to revise the statutes, ordinances, formats, and regulations together.
proposals.reason: 蕭頃 is Xiao Qing; Qi does not match the given name 頃.

decisions.reason: Focus unit names exactly ten officials ending in 王伸等一十人; 等 closes the named list and 一十人 confirms the total is those ten. Adding 'and nine others' invents extra persons after all ten are already listed; the proposed cut restores the count.

sourceWitness.excerpt: 侍御史知雜事張湜、太子右庶子劇可久、殿中侍御史率汀、職方郎中鄧守中、倉部郎中王瑩、司封員外郎賈比、太常博士趙礪、國子博士李光贊、大理正蘇曉、太子中允王伸等一十人

decisions.reason: The same Chinese list ends 王伸等一十人: ten named men, not ten including nine unnamed others. Removing 'and nine others' from the literal matches 一十人 without inventing surplus assignees.
Chinese opens with 臣質、臣溥 as the memorialists who 據文評議; the idiomatic 'We' drops those named subjects. Restoring Zhi and Pu recovers the attribution already present in the literal.
Under 捶楚, 或陷無辜 means some innocent people are trapped or framed into guilt, not that anyone 'falls into guiltlessness.' The proposed wording matches that sense and the idiomatic field.
The censor is 蕭頃; 頃 is Qing (qǐng), not Qi. Replacing Xiao Qi with Xiao Qing corrects the given-name romanization while leaving titles and the rest of the sentence unchanged.
Literal likewise misreads 蕭頃 as Xiao Qi; Xiao Qing is the matching romanization of 頃 and aligns with the idiomatic repair.

claimRevisions.reason: Accepted r0005 shows English Xiao Qi came only from misreading 頃; the personal-name claim must use Xiao Qing while keeping zh, pinyin, id, subject, predicate, certainty, and evidence.
